title: 第9章 痛苦的莫轻柔第10章 夜幕斩杀
lines: 炎阳书院，中央大殿！
“李使者，这件事不能通融一下吗？”
“神力境，都已经能在炎阳书院当老师了。”
叶寒来到殿外，顿时就听到大殿内传出苏啸苍院主无奈的声音。
“通融？苏啸苍，你将轮回书院的规矩当什么了？”
一道年轻而冷厉的声音传出：“若无人踏入神力境，那我也该回去了，不浪费时间了。”
这时，叶寒就听到老师的声音响起：“李凯，轮回书院我清楚，不会拥有这般规矩，你不过一负责此事的普通弟子，竟敢私设规矩。”
“莫轻柔！”
那年轻的声音立刻充满嘲讽：“你看不起我普通弟子的身份？你也不过是一个九年前被排挤出去的失败者，也敢妄谈轮回书院的规矩。”
殿外的叶寒，不禁捏紧了拳头，迈入大殿之中。
他赫然看到大殿最上方盘坐着一个年约二十三四的年轻人，纵然是院主苏啸苍都只能屈居侧坐。
年轻人嚣张跋扈，言语肆无忌惮：“至于书院规矩，风师兄的话就是规矩，尹师姐的话就是规矩，你不爽，可以前去轮回书院告状，看看能翻起什么浪花。”
整座大殿顿时寂静下来，所有人都仰首看着那李凯，却连院主都不敢多言。
事出必有因，无风不起浪！
苏啸苍是知道莫轻柔身份的，此次神力境才能前去轮回书院的限制，根本就是为了刁难莫轻柔师徒。
可就算苏啸苍是炎阳书院这一处分院的院主，也无法扭转此事。
面对这李凯依旧要小心翼翼，否则很可能影响到以后每年炎阳书院弟子能否进入轮回书院。
“还有，我听说你的弟子叶寒不长眼，居然敢大闹叶家，这件事已传到轮回书院。”
“叶芷萱师姐颇为不满，已将此事上禀风师兄，实话告诉你，那叶寒这辈子休想踏入轮回书院了，此次这神力境的硬性要求，就是风师兄定下的。”李凯声音暴涨几分。
“那叶芷萱不过刚刚进入轮回书院，你叫她师姐？”莫轻柔看了一眼李凯。
李凯冷哼一声：“叫一声师姐怎么了？叶芷萱虽刚入书院，却已在风师兄的钦点下直接成为内门弟子。”
“叶芷萱直接晋升内门弟子？难道……？”莫轻柔终于动容。
“不错！”
李凯得意洋洋：“两年前，风师兄就已经晋升为第一个轮回之子。”
这时，李凯话音一转：“不过呢，莫轻柔，世事皆无定数，你的弟子想加入轮回书院，倒也并非没有转机。”
“不用了！”
“那轮回书院，我叶寒不去也罢！”
开口的是叶寒，刹那间，诸多目光齐刷刷转移过来，殿内众人才注意到不知何时踏入的叶寒。
扫了一眼上方的李凯，叶寒来到莫轻柔身边：“老师，世间万道，皆可步步登天，我不见得要加入轮回书院。”
时过境迁，叶寒的心境在变！
轮回书院若皆是这些嚣张跋扈目空一切的弟子，以小见大，可想而知轮回书院的那些高层都是什么品行。
“这就是你的弟子？”上方传来李凯的声音。
他的眼眸俯瞰下来，充满了不屑，如同高高在上的帝王在审视卑贱的臣子。
“聚元九重天？在炎城这破地方还算可以了，你肯定不愿看着叶寒在这小小的炎城平庸下去吧？”
“实话实说，此次前来，我是秉承了尹师姐的意志，莫轻柔，只要你能够将那半块九阳火玉交出来，并亲自回书院帮尹师姐炼化，那么她可前去向风师兄说情，让你的弟子加入轮回书院。”李凯炯炯有神，盯视着莫轻柔。
content_en:
Yanyang Academy, Central Hall!
"Envoy Li, can't we be accommodating on this matter?"
"In the realm of divine power, you can already be a teacher in Yanyang Academy."
Ye Han came outside the hall and immediately heard the helpless voice of Master Su Xiaocang coming from the hall.
"Accommodating? Su Xiaocang, what do you take the rules of Samsara Academy for?"
A young and cold voice came out: "If no one steps into the realm of divine power, then it's time for me to go back. I won't waste any more time."
At this time, Ye Han heard the teacher's voice: "Li Kai, I know that Samsara Academy will not have such rules. You are just an ordinary disciple in charge of this matter, and you dare to set up private rules."
"Mo Qingrou!"
The young voice was immediately filled with ridicule: "You look down on my status as an ordinary disciple? You are just a loser who was pushed out nine years ago, and you still dare to talk about the rules of Samsara Academy."
Ye Han outside the hall couldn't help but clenched his fists and stepped into the hall.
He suddenly saw a young man about twenty-three or four years old sitting cross-legged at the top of the hall. Even the head of the courtyard, Su Xiaocang, could only sit sideways.
The young man was arrogant and domineering, speaking unscrupulously: "As for the rules of the academy, Senior Brother Feng's words are the rules, and Senior Sister Yin's words are the rules. If you are unhappy, you can go to Samsara Academy to file a complaint and see what kind of trouble it will cause."
The whole hall suddenly fell silent. Everyone looked up at Li Kai, but even the master of the hall did not dare to say anything.
Everything happens for a reason, there is no smoke without fire!
Su Xiaocang knew Mo Qingrou's identity, and the restriction of being able to go to Samsara Academy in the divine power realm this time was simply to make things difficult for Mo Qingrou's master and disciple.
But even if Su Xiaocang was the head of the branch of Yanyang Academy, he could not reverse this matter.
Li Kai still had to be cautious when facing this, otherwise it might affect whether Yanyang Academy disciples can enter Samsara Academy every year in the future.
"Also, I heard that your disciple Ye Han has no eyesight and actually dares to cause trouble in the Ye family. This matter has been spread to the Reincarnation Academy."
"Senior Sister Ye Zhixuan is quite dissatisfied and has reported this matter to Senior Brother Feng. To tell you the truth, Ye Han will never step into the Reincarnation Academy in this life. The mandatory requirement for the divine power realm this time was set by Senior Brother Feng." Li Kai's voice rose a bit.
"Then Ye Zhixuan has just entered Samsara Academy, you call her senior sister?" Mo Qingrou glanced at Li Kai.
Li Kai snorted coldly: "What's wrong with calling me Senior Sister? Although Ye Zhixuan has just entered the academy, she has directly become an inner disciple under the hand of Senior Brother Feng."
"Ye Zhixuan was directly promoted to inner disciple? Could it be...?" Mo Qingrou was finally moved.
"Not bad!"
Li Kai was proud: "Two years ago, Senior Brother Feng was promoted to the first Son of Reincarnation."
At this time, Li Kai's voice changed: "But, Mo Qingrou, everything in the world is uncertain. Your disciple wants to join the Reincarnation Academy, but it is not without a chance."
"No need!"
"It's okay if I, Ye Han, don't go to Samsara Academy!"
It was Ye Han who spoke. In an instant, many eyes turned to him, and everyone in the hall noticed Ye Han who had walked in at some unknown time.
Glancing at Li Kai above, Ye Han came to Mo Qingrou's side: "Teacher, everyone in this world can reach the sky step by step. I don't necessarily want to join the Reincarnation Academy."
As time passes, Ye Han's mood is changing!
If the Samsara Academy were all filled with these arrogant, domineering and supercilious disciples, and they could see the greatness from the small, one could only imagine the character of the senior leaders of the Samsara Academy.
"Is this your disciple?" Li Kai's voice came from above.
His eyes looked down, full of disdain, like a superior emperor looking at his humble ministers.
"Juyuan Ninth Level Heaven? It's not bad in this miserable place in Yancheng. You definitely don't want to see Ye Han become mediocre in this small Yancheng, right?"
"To be honest, I am following Senior Sister Yin's will when I come here this time. Mo Qingrou, as long as you can hand over the half piece of Nine Yang Fire Jade and go back to the academy to help Senior Sister Yin refine it in person, then she can go to Senior Brother Feng to intercede and let your disciple join Samsara Academy." Li Kai stared at Mo Qingrou with a bright look.
